intro: The Rosario Islands are a paradisiacal archipelago about 45 minutes by boat from Cartagena. With more than 27 islands, these jewels of the Colombian Caribbean offer white sand beaches, crystal-clear waters, and impressive marine biodiversity. It’s the ideal destination for snorkeling, diving, kayaking, or just relaxing under the sun.
tours: Tours usually include transport, lunch, and water activities. You can choose between day trips and day passes at hotels on the islands. For more privacy, consider renting a private boat to explore less crowded coves.
reserve: Tours can be booked at the Muelle de la Bodeguita, near the Clock Tower.
tip: Avoid bringing valuables and stay hydrated during the day.
